Set an output's brightness through its backlight or DDC/CI

Usage: lys-shell brightness [OPTIONS] <CHANGE>

Arguments:
  <CHANGE>  Percent: N sets, +N raises, -N lowers; never below modules.brightness.min-brightness

Options:
  -o, --output <NAME>  Output connector name (e.g. DP-1); the focused output when omitted
  -h, --help           Print help
